result: A capability decline of 3cp or more is rejected (p < 1e-5) in all six specifications; the 90% CI upper bound remains below zero throughout.
claim: Proposition 3 supported: no meaningful capability decline over 11 years of engine-era play under low r_cap (engines barred during rated games).
sesoi_justification: 3cp is ~5% of the observed mean ACPL (~55cp) and the most conservative of the thresholds examined; 5cp and 8cp also reject, reported as insensitivity checks.
not_claimed: Improvement is NOT claimed as robust: the difference test weakened under a 2-98pct ACPL trim (p=0.092, effect -2.005 -> -1.196) and under n_positions>=300 (p=0.099, n=128). Only the equivalence (no-decline) claim is made.
limitations: Players aged 11 years; developmental improvement may mask decline (power limitation)
Survivorship: cohort active in both 2014 and 2025
Engine depth 12; adequate for group means
Reliance r not observed; inferred from r_cap structure only
